address: Per Henrik Lings Allé 4, 8. Sal, 2100 København, Denmark
bio: Geranium was the first ever Danish and Nordic three-Michelin star restaurant, recieving their first award in 2016. Located on the 8th floor of Parken Stadium, home to the Danish National Team and F.C. København, guests are treated not only to world-class cuisine but also to panoramic views over the city's expansive green spaces. Led by renowned Chef Rasmus Kofoed, a Bocuse d'Or gold medalist celebrated for his artistry and precision, the restaurant has become a global destination for modern Nordic dining. Its tasting menu offers an immersive journey through the seasons, highlighting the purity and delicacy of Scandinavian ingredients with an emphasis on vegetables, herbs, seafood, and foraged elements, all prepared with a philosophy rooted in sustainability and respect for nature. Each dish reflects Geranium's commitment to innovation and balance, creating a dining experience that is as visually striking as it is flavorful, blending contemporary technique with a deep sense of place.
